title: Physician Recertification for Long-Term Hardship Hold Status Reviews — Hardship and Protective Holds
content:
## Guidance

Under Hardship and Protective Holds, before each status review of a running Long-Term Hardship Hold, Ridgeline asks the consumer for an updated physician's medical or disability certification, because the review continues the hold only on a certification that shows the serious illness, disability or long-term unemployment still holds.

## Conditions on the request

The recertification request is not sent until every documentation submission on the consumer's other undecided Long-Term Hardship Hold requests that still show no complete-documentation date carries a documentation request dated on or after the day that submission arrived, so that the physician completes one certification for all of them.

The recertification due date is not worked out until an income records request with a due date still ahead stands on the hold.

Restated as states of the records:

| Record state | Effect on the recertification |
|---|---|
| On one of the consumer's other undecided Long-Term Hardship Hold requests with no complete-documentation date, a documentation submission has no documentation request dated on or after the day it arrived | The recertification request is not sent |
| Every such submission carries a documentation request dated on or after the day it arrived (or there is no such submission) | This condition does not hold the request back |
| No income records request with a due date still ahead stands on the hold | The recertification due date is not worked out |
| An income records request with a due date still ahead stands on the hold | This condition does not hold the due date back |

## What the request states

The request states the days allowed for the recertification: the calendar days from the day of the request to the recertification due date, a whole number.

## Tool card: `request_medical_recertification_c8d32721`

**Capability.** Asks the consumer for an updated physician's medical or disability certification for an upcoming status review of a running hardship hold. One call records one documentation request for the certification in the hold history, dated today, with a due date the given number of calendar days after today. The hold itself is not changed. On success the request and its due date appear in the hold history.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `request_medical_recertification_c8d32721` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `hold_id` — the hold reference number of the running hold under review, read from the hardship hold lookup. Identifier.
- `due_in_days` — the number of calendar days from today to the due date of the certification, a whole integer of at least 1 (1 means tomorrow); no decimals, no empty value.

**Return.** A dictionary rendered as text with `request_ref` (the reference of the recorded request), `hold_id`, `document_type` (always `medical_or_disability_certification`), `due_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `sent_on` (YYYY-MM-DD, today) and `status`, always `requested` when the request is recorded.

**Input and receipt (hypothetical).** Called on 20 June with `due_in_days` of 30, the request is recorded with a `due_date` of 20 July.
